title: 第70章 珍宝楼的邀请第69章 先天武骨和后天武骨
slug: 莫欺老年穷一天增加一个天赋点
lines: 中年管事闻言，竟是失声而笑。
他悠然地提起紫砂壶，为陈安面前那只空杯续上滚烫的茶水，氤氲的白雾模糊了他那张儒雅的面容。
“老先生说笑了。”
“六百多两黄金，放在雷云县，或许是一笔泼天巨富。可在我珍宝楼眼中，还远不值得在下亲自出面。”
话音落下，他不再绕任何圈子，目光灼灼地看着陈安，一字一句，清晰无比。
“在下今日相邀，是想代表珍宝楼，正式邀请老先生，成为我珍宝楼的……客卿。”
客卿！
陈安端着茶杯的手指，没有丝毫颤动，但眼底深处，却有一道精光一闪而逝。
他深知，天下没有白吃的午餐。
这两个字背后，必然牵扯着相应的义务与代价。
“为何？”
他放下茶杯。
“因为老先生您，练成了它。”
中年管事指了指陈安放在一旁的包裹，那里面，静静躺着《金刚不坏身》的锻骨篇。
“不瞒您说，最初引起我注意的，并非是您豪掷千金，而是在短短不到半年之内，竟有两个人，以截然不同的身份，先后买走了《金刚不坏身》的炼皮篇与锻骨篇。”
管事眼中闪烁着光芒，仿佛一切尽在掌握。
“这门功法，修炼方式酷烈，近乎自残。在旁人眼中，是鸡肋，是废品。但在我珍宝楼，它却有另一个名字……试金石。”
“一块专门用来筛选真正天才的试金石。”
他缓缓揭开了谜底：“此功法对根骨的要求近乎没有，但对修炼者的意志、悟性，尤其是肉身的恢复力，却有着堪称变态的要求。百年来，经我珍宝楼之手卖出的拓本不下千份，无数人尝试，最终能将九品三境——炼皮、炼筋、炼脏，全部修至圆满的……”
“无一例外，皆是身怀武骨的奇才！”
“任何能凭此功修成九品圆满之人，都是我珍宝楼极力招揽的对象。”管事话锋一转，目光重新落在陈安那苍老的面容上，惊叹之色再度浮现，“而老先生您，竟能以行将就木之躯，逆天改命，催生出后天武骨，并修成此功……这等万中无一的例子，让这份邀请，变得势在必得。”
陈安面色依旧平静，心中却已了然。
原来如此。
说白了，《金刚不坏身》就是珍宝楼故意拿出来的。
炼不会无所谓，反正他们赚到钱了。
炼会了，反而让珍宝楼知晓你的天赋，毅力之类的很不错，值得他们邀请。
这样的手段，倒也算得上比较高明了。
广撒网嘛。
只不过，陈安没有被这番吹捧冲昏头脑，而是继续追问。
“成为客卿，有何好处？”
他只关心这个。
唯有能握在手里的力量，才是乱世安身立命的根本。
“哈哈哈，老先生果然是爽快人！”
中年管事见他如此直接，眼中的欣赏之色愈发浓郁。
他知道，对这种人，任何花言巧语都是多余的。
他身体微微前倾，压低了声音。
“珍宝楼，并非寻常商会。”
“它真正的名字，叫内务司，直属于大乾皇室。我们的网络，遍布王朝九郡，能量之大，远超老先生您对任何一个地方势力的想象。”
大乾皇室！
陈安心头猛地一跳。
content_en:
The middle-aged steward burst out laughing when he heard this.
He leisurely lifted up the purple clay teapot and refilled the empty cup in front of Chen An with hot tea. The dense white mist blurred his elegant face.
"The old gentleman was joking."
"More than six hundred taels of gold, if placed in Leiyun County, may be a huge fortune. But in the eyes of my Zhenbao Tower, it is far from worthy of my personal appearance."
After the words fell, he stopped going around in circles and looked at Chen An with burning eyes, every word was very clear.
"I invite you today because I want to represent Zhenbao Tower and formally invite the old gentleman to become my... guest at Zhenbao Tower."
Dear guest!
Chen An's fingers holding the tea cup did not tremble at all, but deep in his eyes, there was a flash of light.
He knows that there is no such thing as a free lunch.
Behind these two words, there must be corresponding obligations and prices involved.
"Why?"
He put down his tea cup.
"Because you, old man, have mastered it."
The middle-aged steward pointed to the package Chen An placed aside. Inside, lying quietly was the bone-forging chapter of "The Indestructible Body of Vajra."
"To be honest, what first caught my attention was not your lavish spending, but that in less than half a year, two people, with completely different identities, bought the skin-refining chapter and the bone-forging chapter of "The Indestructible Body"."
The steward's eyes sparkled, as if he had everything under control.
"This method of cultivation is cruel and almost self-inflicted. In the eyes of others, it is worthless and useless. But in my Zhenbao Building, it has another name... Touchstone."
"A touchstone designed to screen out true genius."
He slowly revealed the mystery: "This technique has almost no requirements on the bones, but it has extremely perverted requirements on the practitioner's will, understanding, and especially the recovery of the physical body. Over the past hundred years, no less than a thousand rubbings have been sold by my Zhenbao Tower. Countless people have tried, and finally they can complete the ninth level of the three realms - skin refining, muscle refining, and internal organ refining..."
"Without exception, they are all geniuses with martial arts skills!"
"Anyone who can achieve the ninth level of perfection with this skill is the target of my Zhenbao Pavilion's efforts to recruit." The manager changed the topic and his eyes fell on Chen An's old face again, and his expression of amazement reappeared, "And you, old man, can actually use your dying body to change your fate against the will of heaven, give birth to acquired martial arts bones, and achieve this skill... Such a unique example makes this invitation inevitable."
Chen An's face remained calm, but he understood in his heart.
I see.
To put it bluntly, "The Indestructible Vajra" was deliberately produced by Zhenbaolou.
It doesn't matter whether they practice or not, they are making money anyway.
After practicing, it will let Zhenbao Tower know that your talents, perseverance and so on are very good and worthy of their invitation.
This method can be considered quite clever.
Cast a wide net.
However, Chen An was not dazzled by the flattery and continued to ask questions.
"What are the benefits of becoming a guest?"
That's all he cares about.
Only the power you can hold in your hands is the foundation for settling down in troubled times.
"Hahaha, the old gentleman is indeed a cheerful person!"
When the middle-aged manager saw him being so direct, the admiration in his eyes became more intense.
He knew that for such a person, any rhetoric would be superfluous.
He leaned forward slightly and lowered his voice.
"Jianbao Building is not an ordinary chamber of commerce."
"Its real name is the Department of Internal Affairs, and it belongs directly to the Daqian royal family. Our network spreads across the nine counties of the dynasty, and its power is far beyond your imagination of any local power, Mr."
Fight the royal family!
Chen An's head jumped suddenly.
